title: Hysab Kytab v1.1.0
message: Major AI & Khata Ledger Upgrade: High-precision Gemini AI engine with offline backup, streamlined From/To Khata flows, multiline keyboard with newline support, and input visibility fixes.
changelog: New Hysab Kytab AI engine powered by Google Gemini with 1,500 daily requests and on-device offline fallback
Streamlined Khata flows: Clear From and To counterparty tracking for borrowed, lent, and received funds
Smart Expense vs Khata detection: Purchasing items for family or friends remains an Expense with names in description
Keyboard & Chat Input fix: Input bar remains visible above mobile keyboard with return key inserting newlines
